faqs.question: Can I invite multiple team members with different permissions?
faqs.answer: Yes! Standard and Premium tiers include multi-user role management with granular roles like Admin, Accountant, Sales Rep, and Inventory Auditor.

faqs.question: Does Bookkip work offline or during network dropouts?
faqs.answer: Bookkip saves drafts locally in your browser storage and synchronizes safely once your connection is restored.

faqs.question: Can I receive online card payments directly on my invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes, Bookkip integrates natively with Paystack and Flutterwave. Your clients can click to pay via card, bank transfer, or USSD.

faqs.question: What is the Once and For All Lifetime plan?
faqs.answer: Our Lifetime plan grants permanent access for up to 5 business locations with zero recurring annual or monthly fees ever.
